texts.preamble: Paletinarayana Reddy, vs State Of Ap on 16 August, 2019 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu Criminal Petition No.3695 of 2019 Order:
texts.arguments: The case of the petitioner is that the charge sheet that has been filed is not maintainable as the same is filed under section 7 read with 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act. The foremost submission is that the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has been repealed and the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 (in short "the FSS Act-2006") has come into force from 05.08.2011. Therefore, he questions the very filing of the charge sheet itself. In addition, learned counsel also submits that the petitioner before this Court is the owner of the premises and that he has leased the said premises to the company in August, 2015 to accused No.2. Therefore, he submits that in view of the rental deeds, which are entered into, he is not responsible for the business and accused No.2 alone can be prosecuted. He prays for quashing of the proceedings. In reply to this, learned Public Prosecutor submits that quashing of the entire proceedings is not called for. He submits that the other sections of IPC also applicable. even if the FSS Act-2006 applies. He also submits that petitioner-Accused No.1 is actively involved in the business and that the lease deeds are created for the purpose of this case.
